scripts.check: node -c main.js && node -c preload.js && node -c smart-deploy.js && node -c build-portable-app.js && node -c service-worker.js && node -c dashboard-local-server.js && node -c daily-outreach-tasks.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('outreach-dashboard.html','utf8'); const scripts=[...html.matchAll(/<script(?![^>]*src)[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi)].map(m=>m[1]); for (const s of scripts) new Function(s); global.window=global; require('./country-market-data.js'); require('./daily-outreach-tasks.js'); if(COUNTRY_ALIASES.usa!=='美国') throw new Error('country aliases failed'); if(!DAILY_OUTREACH_TASKS||DAILY_OUTREACH_TASKS.total!==60) throw new Error('daily outreach tasks failed'); console.log('checks ok')"
